g.title: {"label": "原始Triton", "source_sha256": "770910b7b720dd72ebf498d1baec91d0e254f032d1201da6316747bf290ca585", "case": "case4", "qualified": true, "score": 0.06859796707149637, "latency_ms": 1.90072105, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "", "location": "device", "category": "sim", "replay": {"result": "../experiments/gqa-comparison-20261117/official-check-01.json"}, "axis_label": "原始Triton"}

{"label": "历史round-02：两项概率分解", "source_sha256": "137e585d2838f32b782c4d76af8e9036193e633a99beac9b88551f4313c90727", "case": "case4", "qualified": true, "score": 0.094568900780936, "latency_ms": 1.3787365500000002, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "两项PV分解*\n减少冗余交接", "location": "device", "category": "paired", "attribution": "主来源复核*：蓝色概括profiling＋源码分析联合路径。前一轮profiling触发固定开销调查，本轮测量反馈和第三PV项的源码分析直接触发两项分解；模拟器已实际读取，提供交接位置与成本背景。Read日志确认round-02在修改前读过上述材料。原模拟器实验组、原决策角色及完整结果保持冻结；此处为展示层联合归因，未改写历史工具使用或独立因果。", "replay": {"result": "../experiments/gqa-comparison-20261117/with-simulator-v2/evaluation-round-02/results.json"}, "attribution_review": {"previous_category": "sim", "previous_attribution": "历史模拟器组续接；模型读取及Codex审查反馈共同记录。原始两组对照材料独立保留。", "review": "E:\\0_XSAI\\00_KernelAgent\\kernelgen\\Ascend-Optimization\\development\\reports\\gqa-goal-20261121\\presentation-attribution-review.json", "basis": "事后联合归因，覆盖真实连续两轮：round-01把paired_profiling登记为trigger，提示1024程序和固定交接成本；该轮未改善。round-02的直接trigger为评测反馈及源码中的第三PV项冗余，原始profiling和模拟器均登记background，源码/IR提供具体改法。按profiling定位代价＋源码选择改法这一联合路径归入蓝色*；直接触发角色仍按原决策保存，未主张profiling单独主导或无模拟器也会产生同一结果。", "auxiliary_categories": ["source_ir", "simulator", "evaluation"], "retrospective_primary_review": true}, "axis_label": "第1轮"}

{"label": "attempt-002：因果分流修复、四项通过", "source_sha256": "247091f353b9877d40603d725176b8b1d2418e828d4129da85c413e7f533f524", "case": "case4", "qualified": true, "score": 0.16617300992375272, "latency_ms": 0.78463765, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "KV分块64→128\n按因果条件分流", "location": "host", "category": "sim", "selected_layer": "triton_host_launch", "attribution": "模拟器热点与流水等待支持减少KV循环交接；profiling和IR关联机制。模型先登记后编辑；首版case1编译溢出，依据编译反馈恢复其原分块。核内AST保持，实际修改为宿主分块选择。", "replay": {"result": "night-whitebox-gqa-20261120/gqa/iterations/attempt-002/parent-validation/results.json"}, "axis_label": "第2轮"}

{"label": "attempt-004 · 编译期几何与掩码消除", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "d59c1ca7f3d2a8bd16c9a33bbeecb8b6b0205623174958f83959f0e2da5818fc", "parent_source_sha256": "247091f353b9877d40603d725176b8b1d2418e828d4129da85c413e7f533f524", "qualified": true, "score": 0.1682644087149942, "latency_ms": 0.7748851999999999, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "编译期几何\n消除冗余掩码", "category": "sim", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_compile_time_geometry", "attribution": "Codex修改前读取成对profiling并分析动态元数据；模型修改前独立读取当前模拟器、TTIR和源码，实际成对profiling读取由宿主完成。源码constexpr与元数据整除守卫共同实现几何特化；具体收益和低层变化以完整真机及后重放为准。", "preedit_review": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-004/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-004/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "7389e149620c8c81c6be4a52025104f6fb657e2e50b9c21d6cdcdc165a2acbb5", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第3轮"}

{"label": "attempt-005 · 非因果query行复用", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "23d7322958578d08372dfd9f830f7dc251c4235aa34e7bacf8a3cacdcee90afc", "parent_source_sha256": "d59c1ca7f3d2a8bd16c9a33bbeecb8b6b0205623174958f83959f0e2da5818fc", "qualified": true, "score": 0.27597145962164665, "latency_ms": 0.47246045000000003, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "query行64→128*\n减少重复KV读取", "category": "paired", "location": "host", "selected_layer": "triton_host_launch", "attribution": "主来源复核*：修改前profiling作为trigger提出程序数与重复KV读取问题，源码／TTIR确定M64→128；模拟器已实际读取，作为辅助消歧提供交接等待位置与窗口流水占比。原始共同输入记录保持，未声称工具独立因果。kernel AST保持，完整原四项及后双分析通过。", "preedit_review": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-005/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-continuation-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-005/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "718725e67cb8899038032f60a81706378bacffe9ab221e6df78e81decb1c5bc0", "actual_retention": true, "attribution_review": {"previous_category": "sim", "previous_attribution": "从已验收编译期几何版的当前双分析出发，模型依据交接等待和低Cube productive选择增加M方向复用。只改非因果BLOCK_M，kernel AST与当前精度路径保持。UB资源、实际程序总量和搬运成本以编译、四项及后重放为准；模型GM→L1预测偏差单独记录。", "review": "E:\\0_XSAI\\00_KernelAgent\\kernelgen\\Ascend-Optimization\\development\\reports\\gqa-goal-20261121\\presentation-attribution-review.json", "basis": "修改前decision明确paired_profiling为trigger：1024程序、每程序Cube1.087μs和等待9.150μs，并与CANN19程序对比；源码确认M64与重复KV循环。模拟器按disambiguation记录，提供局部等待位置与低生产占比。主箭头选择profiling，保留模拟器共同参与；该主辅排序为本次事后复核。", "auxiliary_categories": ["simulator", "source_ir"], "retrospective_primary_review": true}, "axis_label": "第4轮"}

{"label": "attempt-004 · BF16路径单次FP16 PV", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "fb1233ed36410fed5adc7c210b0a4247f9ebc4ed54461feeffd450ec679003a6", "parent_source_sha256": "23d7322958578d08372dfd9f830f7dc251c4235aa34e7bacf8a3cacdcee90afc", "qualified": true, "score": 0.325790638656405, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.40021285, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "FP16中间PV\n减少一次矩阵乘", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_device_and_metadata", "attribution": "Codex核对原[-1,1]合同值域、官方误差条件及CANN／候选搬运差异，提出单次FP16概率与V乘法；模型读取profiling、TTIR／BCMLIR后登记并实现。原四项checker与阈值保持。前置证据为profiling＋源码／IR，宿主保留历史模拟器知识；修改后重放单独记录。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-004/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-004/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "62dbff1e85a087782704b1908c3076d5dc05f4273b6e9257ee06b6430cb6358f", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第5轮"}

{"label": "attempt-006 · 整块KV与单轮特化", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "aec8e907f907a8d647f70a343ba0fd38d3d848636a586276f96084e30930895d", "parent_source_sha256": "fb1233ed36410fed5adc7c210b0a4247f9ebc4ed54461feeffd450ec679003a6", "qualified": true, "score": 0.3969763139723085, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.3284468, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "单次PV＋整块KV\n去初始重缩放", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_device_and_metadata", "attribution": "从已验收004出发。模型读取当前profiling与实际IR，改选BN256并显式特化恰好一个KV块的路径，消除初始零acc/l重缩放。实际改法与宿主原指定M256分别记录；M256另由007实测。输入未新增前置模拟器报告，宿主保留历史知识，后重放单列。实际修改为Triton源码与metadata，IR用于解释。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-006/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-006/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "5889d36520cf57b9d7246c1c231a3d4809bf3b9661ae4c2744768b6cdbc2d852", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第6轮"}

{"label": "attempt-017 · 共享KV头持久复用", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "beeb2335d99a34262701b9023d62b816f7621381eaada3500506d6dde805f9f4", "parent_source_sha256": "aec8e907f907a8d647f70a343ba0fd38d3d848636a586276f96084e30930895d", "qualified": true, "score": 0.48511637009537467, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.2687718, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "固定KV头复用\n循环query分块", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_and_host_launch", "attribution": "当前profiling流量与源码/实际IR支持跨query复用，模型把K/V载入和V转换移至querytile循环外，32program；268.7718μs完整及后双分析通过。宿主保留此前模拟器知识，此轮未新增前置模拟器，工具独立增量继续分开。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-017/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-017/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "7b57adb2d38a0f1c0eb9b24731f70c01ecdf86ce28eb631f9ea231b8c5ff274a", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第7轮"}

{"label": "attempt-019 · 持久复用与并行度平衡", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "2a98e3e0c1b1bf631f88c0d613b98d4532bb6273fccf4441291dda87fe749113", "parent_source_sha256": "beeb2335d99a34262701b9023d62b816f7621381eaada3500506d6dde805f9f4", "qualified": true, "score": 0.4971279492827737, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.26227775000000003, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "每组两个query头\n增加并行程序", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_and_host_launch", "attribution": "从017把共享KV头拆为2头子组，32→128program、每program16→4tile；GM→L1 52→64MiB。262.27775μs，原四项、后双分析及条件交错计时通过；全调用收益与独立kernel近似分别记录。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-019/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-019/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "541b54f40781247ed7727948be62b666ce3ad36ece7875f4512bf329ae4ccbc5", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第8轮"}

{"label": "attempt-029 · 20个常驻程序均分tile", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "2ffb6f6125d0b2ea3a06593661b9bba034a3df04040ec4610de4b0a982aaab9f", "parent_source_sha256": "2a98e3e0c1b1bf631f88c0d613b98d4532bb6273fccf4441291dda87fe749113", "qualified": true, "score": 0.5614332424563608, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.23223705, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "连续tile均分\n按KV组复用", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_and_host_launch", "attribution": "从019独立出发，profiling与源码指导20worker按连续tile区间调度；目标每程序25或26tile、KV组加载48次。原四项232.23705μs、0.553×CANN，硬件226.164520μs；后双分析及自动关联通过并保留，GM→L1 64→54MiB、L0C96MiB保持，时钟局部偏差与部分窗口保留。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-029/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-029/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "21e0ee9ac1993f5782d30c5a05bfeb1c77e3e1931163131bf89eca05c793845f", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第9轮"}

{"label": "attempt-031 · 公共指数偏移替代逐行max", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "e7fad4d8519526ea1731371e47d7ddb1417300145d28d14f4dca49bffbabee9b", "parent_source_sha256": "2ffb6f6125d0b2ea3a06593661b9bba034a3df04040ec4610de4b0a982aaab9f", "qualified": true, "score": 0.6351469414467703, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.20528415, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "公共指数偏移\n省去max归约", "category": "paired", "location": "mixed", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_and_constexpr", "attribution": "宿主由profiling与源码提出公共指数偏移，模型修改前读取029模拟器与TTIR并保留辅助判断。原四项205.28415μs、0.631786×CANN及后双分析完成，硬件205.624115μs；Vector累计1587.885→1201.784μs。固定均匀输入合同及极端负值行下溢风险单列，正式样本分离与硬件方向一致，按条件策略省略ABBA。短指令0.01μs量化导致初始时钟核验失败，较长指令独立校准22/22、22/22、21/21通过，原失败保留。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-031/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-031/parent-validation/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "c49566f12305eefc1262c4e4fcb61985119c0b54ae1a90b9d619b287795888c7", "actual_retention": true, "axis_label": "第10轮"}

{"label": "attempt-033 · QK中间结果FP16交接", "case": "case4", "source_sha256": "99e77cb819ea900a6ca6cebfacb26777879a756d7256abb7d15f736334445031", "parent_source_sha256": "e7fad4d8519526ea1731371e47d7ddb1417300145d28d14f4dca49bffbabee9b", "qualified": true, "score": 0.6646963177415774, "presentation_eligible": true, "latency_ms": 0.19615815, "score_is_rebased": true, "method": "QK结果缩窄\n恢复FP32做softmax", "category": "sim", "location": "device", "selected_layer": "triton_kernel_source", "attribution": "修改前031模拟器FIXP热点区分QK与PV搬出，profiling与实际IR支持。QK交接缩窄后L0C→GM96→64MiB、kernel205.624→191.024μs。首次完整调用波动，条件交错确认下降5.42%；一次原四项复测196.15815μs、同轮0.641909×CANN，后双分析及执行代码关联通过。首次记录保留详情，同实现复测无独立图点。", "preedit_review": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/agent-calls/attempt-033/host-review.json", "replay": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/conditional-remeasurement/attempt-033/results.json"}, "formal_result_sha256": "42d05b2d012c64e7a252bf5b688f3d72a4216cdff706bc29e58ee0c4497b7bae", "actual_retention": true, "original_measurement": {"result": "gqa-goal-20261121/gqa/iterations/attempt-033/parent-validation/results.json", "sha256": "a912089b9545a80795e896ffd3ba4fdacbaeed9d22048801ea0276d183bf78a0", "scope": "Same-source measurement retained in details"}, "axis_label": "第11轮"}
